entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's wrong, Joker? Do you need to think[n]this over?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, is everything okay? Let's check it over[n]with everyone.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, time for me to shine![n]The code was, uh... H-E-W-J?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's H-U-G-E, you moron! Learn to spell!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, we have hints from that journal[n]and the torn pages, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. If we combine all the information[n]at hand, we should be able to solve this...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps we should sort through[n]everything once more.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, we've gotten some more info here,[n]but not enough. Do you think we might[n]be missing pages...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps. We should search the area again,[n]to be safe.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Actually, we haven't picked up any pages[n]in here yet.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Does that mean we'll need to look around[n]to find them?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems so. Let us do that.
